svg.title: HTND memory under default settings: no cap vs. a 7 GiB cap
svg.desc: Two panels, node A (with UTXO index) and node B (without), x axis hours since the start of phase A (0 to about 21.2 h), y axis GiB. Lines: cgroup memory including page cache, and anonymous process memory, from 5 s samples (sampling began about 1.3 h into phase A). Phase A (no cap, about 10.6 h): anonymous memory median 6.18 GiB (A) and 5.70 GiB (B), maximum 7.55 and 7.50 GiB; cgroup memory reaches about 10.9 GiB with page cache. Phase B (shaded, MemoryMax=7G, about 10.6 h): cgroup memory sits at the 7 GiB cap (dashed line); anonymous memory median 6.12 and 5.79 GiB, maximum 6.98 and 6.95 GiB. Green bands mark pruning-point UTXO set updates (seven per node). Crosses mark OOM kills: node A at about 15.6 h (no move running) and about 20.15 h, node B at about 20.08 h, the latter two during the same pruning-point move; the process restarted within about 10 s each time.

g.text: HTND memory under default settings: no cap vs. a 7 GiB cap
5 s samples of the htnd.service cgroup. Default settings; phase B adds MemoryMax=7G and MemorySwapMax=0.
5 s sampling began about 1.3 h into phase A. Green bands: pruning-point UTXO set update running (node log).
Shaded: phase B. OOM kills from the service journal; the process restarted within about 10 s each time.
